expansionSections.heading: Quit Plans And Nicotine Replacement Therapy

deepDiveBlocks.heading: NHS Stop Smoking Support
paragraphs: Pharmacy stop smoking services combine behavioural support with licensed nicotine replacement therapy where eligible under NHS pathways.
Regular reviews improve quit rates compared with unassisted attempts — relapse is common and support continues without judgement.

timelineNotes: Week 1: quit date and NRT initiation
Week 12: progress review and relapse prevention
comparisonPoints: NHS support may cover products for eligible patients
Specialist mental health support needed for complex cases
